name: FleetPods
author: DMac
description: AirPods switching that works past two devices. FleetPods lets your Omarchy machines request and yield the AirPods' two connections like Apple devices do, shows live seats, playback, and battery in the bar, and supports the high-resolution AirPods microphone for calls and recording. Tested with AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2; includes a companion user daemon.

barWidget.description: AirPods switching across Omarchy and Apple devices: live seats and playback, bud and case battery, high-resolution microphone, and automatic takeover when you press play on a fleet machine.
